prompt: Nora submitted the replay quiz while covering Dispatch. The next morning no training credit appears, and she is due to cover Dispatch again, this time at the loading counter. What is the appropriate response?
promptZh: Nora 支援出貨組時交了錄影測驗。翌日早上紀錄仍無訓練時數，而她原定再次支援出貨組，這次在裝貨服務台。怎麼處理才符合通知？

options.text: Ask the Dispatch supervisor to add the credit and keep the loading assignment.
options.zh: 請出貨組主管補登時數，並照原安排去裝貨服務台。
options.whyZh: 受支援組主管不能核准時數。紀錄尚未補上前也不可支援裝貨服務台。

options.text: Ask both supervisors to record the briefing and work at the customer desk without notifying training.
options.zh: 請兩位主管各登記說明會，再去顧客服務台，不必告知訓練服務台。
options.whyZh: 排班可調整，但不能請兩位主管重複登記；仍須向訓練服務台提供資料。

options.text: Work at the loading counter because the quiz was submitted, then report the missing credit later.
options.zh: 既然已交測驗，就先去裝貨服務台，之後再通報時數缺漏。
options.whyZh: 限制依據是有無登記，不是已交測驗但未入帳。

options.text: Send the date and briefing title to training, and ask the host supervisor to move her to the customer desk for that shift.
options.zh: 將完成日期和說明會名稱寄給訓練服務台，並請受支援團隊主管將該班改到顧客服務台。
options.whyZh: 補登與排班是兩個不同權責。紀錄缺漏時向訓練服務台通報；主管可先另派至顧客服務台。

explanationZh: 補登與排班是兩個不同權責。紀錄缺漏時向訓練服務台通報；主管可先另派至顧客服務台。
evidence: The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count. | A cover shift is a shift you work for another team. Training done during a cover shift belongs on your usual team’s record, not the host team’s record. Check your record the next morning. If an entry is missing, send the completion date and briefing title to the training desk. Do not ask both supervisors to enter it. | For staff due to cover the loading counter, there is a separate access rule. Anyone without recorded training may cover the customer desk but not the loading counter. If your credit is missing, the host supervisor can change your assignment for that shift; the supervisor cannot approve training credit. The training desk will still need the information above.

vocabulary.note: 把完成的訓練列入正式紀錄。
